tags.description: A colina onde se ergue o Castelo de S. Jorge foi das primeiras áreas ocupadas de Lisboa.Durante a Idade do Ferro e o período romano desempenhou um papel estratégico na defesa do povoado.Ocupado pelos árabes,foi conquistado em 1147 por D. Afonso...
tags.name: Castelo de São Jorge

tags.description: Torre de secção quadrangular, com cerca de 9 m de lado na base, à qual se encontra adossada uma longa escadaria, reconstruída em 1940, que, subindo a colina, estabelece a ligação com o Castelo de S. Jorge. Está classificada como Monumento Naciona

towers.name: Central circulation tower
towers.basis: Preserved raw interior outline and13m mapper height; raw name São Lourenço conflicts with the operator hillside location and is not adopted as identity.

stairs.basis: Third inner-court stair along mapped south-west wall-walk; original current-photo section.

published.precision: Operator approximate Palace Tower plan dimensions and tower/courtyard count; observatory value is an altitude, not relative height.

controls.basis: Complete current inner fortress with ten outer towers plus the central tower, two courts/divider, southern/eastern barbican and real gateways/bridges; current museum/royal-palace remains, hillside São Lourenço tower and its mapped stair link. Original section estimates from operator current imagery, independently attributed map controls and published facts. Main courtY25 versus hillside tower baseY0 is provisional; actual hill/terrace common datum requires terrain/site review.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: Native+X east,+Z south, heading0; original footprint and gateway coordinates preserved.
nativeAxes.origin: Castle horizontal anchor. Provisional court attachment modelY25; actual hillside tower baseY0. Common hill/bridge datum unverified.

reconstruction.scope: Complete current inner fortress exterior, eleven towers/turrets, two open courts, current north roofed towers, periscope and flags, divider, gates/bridges, southern/eastern barbican/moat, current museum/palace exterior remains and hillside tower/stair link
reconstruction.basis: Original deterministic geometry from operator current imagery and separately attributed OSM controls; no copied photograph, plan or mesh redistributed
reconstruction.referenceState: Current monument exterior, not reconstruction of vanished residences or whole city walls; actual hill datum and current facade sections pending.
